reply.text:
That's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't tell you what to do with the wrist or whether it's from the push-ups. A few days of ache is worth having someone look at before you load it further.

I'm glad to keep going on the training side. If you want, tell me what's on today's session and I'll help you think about which work you can leave out until it's been checked, and I'll build around whatever they clear you for.
